title: Simulator: mobility, topology generators, scenario DSL
description:
Three quick wins for simulator usefulness:

1. Mobility - Medium.update_position(node_id, x, y, z)
2. Topology generators - grid(), random_disk(), line()
3. Scenario DSL - YAML with Python escape hatch

Scenario format:
```yaml
topology: grid(9, spacing=100)
events:
  - at: 0s
    spawn: [node-1, node-2]
  - at: 30s
    kill: node-5
  - at: 60s
    move: {node: node-1, to: [200, 0, 0]}
  - at: 120s
    python: |
      if sim.metrics.delivery_rate < 0.8:
          sim.chaos.add_loss(0.2)
```
close_reason: Already fixed: all three features are fully implemented and tested (74 passing tests) — mobility.py provides MobilityManager/RandomWaypoint + Simulation.update_position(); topology.py provides grid()/line()/random_disk()/star(); scenario.py provides full YAML DSL with spawn/kill/move/chaos/python events
